article_notes: Serum phosphoproteome: 10 B. canis-infected dogs (all SIRS positive, none with organ dysfunction at sampling) vs 10 healthy controls. All comparisons are infected vs healthy (individual phosphosite detection in Table 1, Mann-Whitney on spectral intensities, TMT pools); no comparison between severity or outcome groups. A correlation of non-phosphorylated peptide number with alkaline phosphatase in babesiosis cases is mentioned but not shown and is not against severity.
